entries.title: DRAFT source correction: C0048 critical Potts magnetization
entries.statement: Historical conjecture, current 2026 status UNKNOWN: for each integer d>=3 and integer q>=3, the ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor q-state Potts model on Z^d has positive monochromatic-boundary spontaneous magnetization at its critical inverse temperature. In the source's simplex-spin convention, discontinuity means MAG at beta_c. The parenthetical q_c(d)=2 requires a separately specified q-domain and is not part of the cited 2017 Conjecture 2. Free random-cluster nonpercolation at p_c is not included in that conjecture; it is an extra premise in one sufficient pressure route. No proof of C0048 is claimed.

source.excerpt: If the model satisfies (MAG_beta_c), the phase transition is said to be discontinuous

entries.title: DRAFT reviewed lemma: extensive KL deficit of the uniform Potts product law
entries.statement: Let G=(V,E) be a finite simple graph, q>=2 an integer, K>=0, u the uniform independent q-color law, and gamma_K the free ferromagnetic Potts law proportional to exp(K times the number of agreeing edges). Then D(u||gamma_K)>=|E|[log((exp(K)+q-1)/q)-K/q]. Equality holds on forests; for K>0 and a graph with a cycle it is strict. Thus on growing Z^d boxes at any fixed K>0, liminf D(u||gamma_K)/|V|>=d[log((exp(K)+q-1)/q)-K/q]>0. This is a product-law obstruction and does not establish critical discontinuity.
entries.proof_text: Set v=exp(K)-1>=0. The exact Fortuin-Kasteleyn expansion is Z_G(K)=sum_{A subset E} v^|A| q^{k(A)}, with isolated vertices counted. Since k(A)>=|V|-|A|, Z_G>=q^|V|(1+v/q)^|E|. Also D(u||gamma_K)=log Z_G-|V|log q-K|E|/q. Combining gives the bound. The component inequality is equality for all A on a forest; a cycle gives a strict term for K>0. Strict positivity of the bracket follows from strict Jensen for the nonconstant Bernoulli(1/q) agreement indicator. The referee independently rederived the expansion and equality cases in ~/brain_workers/w461/REVIEW_PACKET.md, 2026-10-10. Served-model identity remains UNKNOWN.

relations.rationale: The finite-graph lemma rules out a uniform-product variational shortcut to the C0048 critical jump; it does not prove the conjecture. Both endpoints are stated in this bundle.
The existing C0048 concept carries an unqualified q_c(d)=2 equivalence; this source-scope draft records the exact integer-q primary conjecture and critical magnetization definition.
